sentences.text:
4,000 meters beneath Antarctic ice lies
*Lake Vostok*, sealed for 15 million years.
sentences.spoken: Four thousand meters beneath the East Antarctic ice sheet lies Lake Vostok, a subglacial liquid ocean sealed off from Earth for fifteen million years.

sentences.text:
The lake is the size of *Lake Ontario*,
buried under 4 km of solid glacial ice.
sentences.spoken: Covering fifteen thousand square kilometers, it is nearly the size of Lake Ontario, buried under four kilometers of crushing glacial ice.

sentences.text:
Despite -89°C surface air, geothermal heat
keeps the freshwater lake in a *liquid state*.
sentences.spoken: Despite sitting beneath the coldest surface on Earth at minus eighty-nine degrees, geothermal heat keeps its freshwater reservoir in a liquid state.

sentences.text:
Pressure exceeds *350 atmospheres*,
with 50 times more oxygen than normal water.
sentences.spoken: The pressure here exceeds three hundred and fifty atmospheres, and the water is supersaturated with fifty times more oxygen than normal lakes.

sentences.text:
Scientists drilled thousands of meters,
taking extreme care *not to contaminate the waters*.
sentences.spoken: For decades, Russian drillers bored through thousands of meters of ice cores, taking extreme precautions to avoid contaminating the virgin waters.

sentences.text:
A specialized fluid column balanced the
*immense hydrostatic pressure* of the ice.
sentences.spoken: They used a specialized freon and kerosene fluid column to balance the immense hydrostatic pressure of the overlying ice.

sentences.text:
Core samples revealed thousands of
*novel DNA sequences* from ancient microbes.
sentences.spoken: When the core reached accreted lake ice, genetic analysis revealed thousands of novel DNA sequences from ancient bacteria and fungi.

sentences.text:
These organisms thrived in total darkness,
*feeding only on mineral bedrock vents*.
sentences.spoken: These organisms have thrived in complete total darkness, nourished only by minerals from geothermal bedrock vents.

sentences.text:
Lake Vostok proves life can survive here;
*and perhaps on Jupiter's moon Europa*.
sentences.spoken: Lake Vostok is our closest terrestrial model for Jupiter's ice moon Europa. If life can survive here, life is everywhere in the cosmos.
